image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a marine mollusk, specifically a chiton, clinging to a textured, rocky substrate. The organism has an elongated, oval shape with a distinct segmented dorsal shell consisting of multiple overlapping plates in shades of yellow, orange, and pinkish-purple. The shell is surrounded by a fleshy, leathery girdle that appears pinkish-red. The background consists of blurred marine encrustations and rock textures.
